title: ARCH-REVIEW Output
description: Validates the output payload produced by the ARCH-REVIEW hard-gate agent in the APOS pipeline.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the ARCH-REVIEW output schema.

agent.description: Identifier of the gate agent that produced this output.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 date-time when the review was completed.

review_passed.description: Overall pass/fail verdict of the architecture review gate.

checklist_results.description: Ordered list of checklist items evaluated during the review.

category.description: Architecture-review category this checklist item covers.

passed.description: Whether this individual checklist item passed.

details.description: Human-readable explanation of the evaluation outcome.

blocking.description: When true, a failure in this item blocks the gate from passing.

self_check.description: Self-referential integrity check emitted by the agent.

agent_badge.description: Display badge used to tag log lines from this agent.

output_schema_valid.description: Whether the agent's own output passed schema self-validation.

gate_type.description: Classification of this gate (hard_gate means pipeline halts on failure).
